description_en: A flexible woven hammock chair hung from a horizontal bamboo spreader bar, with a simple fabric seat pad; the front shows the U-shaped seat cavity, the side reveals the draped seat depth and cord suspension, and the rear shows spreader knots and the woven back curve. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
